title: Certificate of Occupancy

origin.publisher: NYC Department of Buildings (certificate); posted by Public Prep, the charter school network occupying the building
origin.title: Temporary Certificate of Occupancy 220152652T005, 192 East 151st Street, Bronx, effective April 16, 2019
origin.clearance_note: A New York City Department of Buildings Temporary Certificate of Occupancy for a school building, posted on the website of Public Prep, the charter school network that occupies it (hosted on Finalsite, a school website platform). Certificates of occupancy are public records, also available through the Department of Buildings' BIS system. The document is a scan with no text layer. It names no private individual: it describes the building, its permitted uses and capacities, and carries the signatures of the Borough Commissioner and the Commissioner in their official capacity. No redaction was needed.

notes: The request named no page or fields. These tell the certificate's status as a real-estate, lending or insurance reviewer reads it: which property, which certificate, and whether it is temporary and when it lapses. The certificate is temporary, valid for 90 days, with 18 outstanding requirements before a final certificate. The use tables on pages 2 and 3 are a scan in which the Floor To column runs into Maximum persons permitted ('001 234'); all 26 rows extract with the right capacities. Blank cells are not always null: three blank Maximum persons cells come back as 0, and the blank Floor To on the cellar and roof rows is filled in from Floor From. issuing_authority grounds to the NYC Buildings logo text and reads OFF.
